title: Bix and classical music
summary: Short exchange on Bix's liking for classical music and Hug's conversation with him.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience

blocks.x: Yeah, it was simple for him.
Yeah. That's right. And who else? I mean, it was anybody else that was simple for other than him.
Yeah, I don't know. Yeah, it really stopped you. Yeah. When you stop to think of it. That's right.
Do you think he listened to classical music then?
Well, they say, Debbie said it was his favorite.
And was it Stravinsky too? Or was it a...
Yeah, Stravinsky, the Firebird Suite. The Firebird Suite, yeah.
They say he liked that. He liked it too.
That was one of his favorites. You never talked to him about that kind of stuff. I didn't ask him about that. No. But you did have a whole conversation with him.
Do you remember what you talked about?
Do you remember what you talked about with him personally, by yourself, or... Well... Or anything? I asked him about... Or what kind of a conversation was he was...
